notes.title: Quality of Life Update
notes.notes:
-Music has changed in the 'Magic Realm'.
-Reduced 'noisy' sound effects for rewards.
-Added support for DPad controls.
-Dash no longer is effected by gravity.
-Buffed Cat Packs damage vs Enemies substantially.
-Milo will now give more hints about bosses and levels.
-Added more swings and perches to 'Golden Burrow'.
-Added more swings and perches to 'Ceremonial Caverns'.

notes.title: Ease of Life Update
notes.notes: The Magic Realm now will guide players to the next level. All level portals are revealed in The Magic Realm. This update will help players of all ages and skill levels find the next challenge more quickly.

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.notes: The Cat Packs Gamepad Layout can now be accessed from the pause menu.

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.notes: Fixed an issue with multiplayer game(s) warping unexpectedly to checkpoints.

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.notes:
General Note: Gamepad Layout was recently added to the website at https://catpacks.us/strategy/

Updates this patch:

- Fixed UI Scaling issue with 4K Displays

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.notes:
General Note: If you are unable to launch the game, you should uninstall and reinstall Cat Packs through the Steam App as some directories may have changed (this should not effect players who installed after 6/3/21).

Updates this patch:

- Cosmetic changes were made in: The Lakeward Expanse, Highland Castle, The Journey Home.

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.notes:
After updating Cat Packs, if you are unable to launch the game, you should uninstall and reinstall because we changed the launcher path in the 6/3/2021 update. We do not intend to change the launcher path again for future releases.

Patch Notes:

- Changed directory location of the build.
- Changed launcher path to the executable.
- Added 'Generic Gamepad' as the default controller configuration.
- Fixed some cosmetic issues in 'Highland Castle'.
